accepted_changes: Bounded subject + action + status grammatical backoff only for existing authored action/status phrases; compare the same pronoun + 做 + status transition, cap at 6 and retain the real object likelihood
Compute immutable grammatical backoff table once during decoder construction, instead of calling the model repeatedly per search path
Include 齊 as a productive action status; reply + 咗/返/緊 can take a known recipient directly without a 畀/俾 marker
Unchanged model, vocabulary, 48-path beam, code matching, local learning storage, Single mode and Fold7 layout
